text:
diego: Follow-up from PM-2026-14 (throughput regression). Dropping a compact owner list + next-steps. Please ACK or request reassignment in 48h. Main goals: clear owners, per-team subtasks, a short RACI for cross-team items, and verification criteria.

Actions (suggested):
- JIRA-9001: per-model request throttles + metric labels (owner: diego)
- JIRA-9002: rollout canary gate + automated rollback (owner: anya, consult: eng-deploy)
- JIRA-9003: runbook update + tabletop (owner: kelly)
- JIRA-9004: KV eviction repeat analysis (owner: ben)
- internal: add "recurrence_review" flag + weekly board card (owner: kelly)

anya: ack JIRA-9002. I'll own the canary gate. Proposed RACI: Anya (R), eng-deploy (C), Diego (A), Ben (I). Will open a subtask for the canary health evaluator.

kelly: ack JIRA-9003 and the internal recurrence flag. I'll push a PR to the ops-runbooks template and schedule a 30m tabletop for validation steps.

ben: taking JIRA-9004. Noted 4 eviction spikes at ~02:12 UTC across the last 21 days. I'll attach time-series, heap dumps, and try a repro with the staged load generator. ETA: initial findings in 3 business days.

diego: For 9001 I'll scope a short-term mitigation (per-model throttles behind feature flags) + long-term adaptive throttling. Quickstop: feature-flag toggle + monitoring. ETA: quickstop in 3 days.

ops-bot: Created subtask JIRA-9002.1 for canary evaluator: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-9002.1

pm-bot: PM flagged as "recurrence_candidate" (occurrences=3). Weekly recurrence-review card added: https://board.redwood.local/postmortems/recurrence

anya: small process request: if a remediation touches >1 team, create a subtask per team with explicit RACI and acceptance criteria. avoids single-owner confusion when closing PM.

kelly: +1. Also proposing a mandatory verification comment format before PM close: code block below for clarity.

kelly: ```
remediation-verification:
  SHA=<git-sha>
  smoke=<smoke-run-id>
  perf_traces=<link>
  notes=<short verification notes>
```

ben: we'll include time-series snapshots and a reproduction note in the ticket before marking done. If we need to split work (infra vs runtime) I'll open subtasks.

diego: I'll add the quick mitigation PR and flag it as "hotfix/9001-qstop". @anya please review the canary gating hook for the same PR set so we can coordinate rollout.

anya: will review. also adding a canary duration default of 20m + p99 gating rule to JIRA-9002.

kelly: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-runbooks/pull/1112 - adds recurrence flag + verification template to PM docs. includes checklist items for "subtask-per-team" and "verification comment required".

ops-bot: Reminder: owners should update the JIRA with RACI, ETA, and link back to this PM thread. Subtasks recommended for cross-team work.

diego: Let's try to keep remediations small and testable: canary -> partial -> full. If anyone wants a swap call it out here or update the Jira assignee. I'll close owner assignment in 48h. Thanks. :thumbsup:

anya: Acked. I'll add eng-deploy as Consulted on JIRA-9002 and open the subtask now.

ben: Ack. Will post dumps and initial analysis by EOD Tue. If repro fails in staging I'll request a short pairing session with infra.

kelly: scheduled tabletop: Fri 09:00 UTC. Added board card and invited oncall.

diego: closing for assignments in 48h unless requested swap.
